title: Integral scalar conjugates for supplied strict models
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ an algebraic closure, and $f:Z\to X$ a morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes. For every specified family $I_E$ of IntegralModels [def-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-data] indexed by finite subextensions of $\Omega$, there are tensor-generator-normalized ordinary and universal-unit-normalized ambient scalar/direct-image comparisons, and natural isomorphisms $I_L S^Z_{L/E}\cong S^X_{L/E}I_E$. They satisfy HasIntegralLaws and HasIntegralCoherence [def-sf-strict-direct-image-integral-coherence]. The strict models are supplied, not constructed, and no rational functor is asserted.

source.place: Agent-expanded strict scalar comparison argument, original DAG Steps 1--8; current blueprint retains only the underlying closed-immersion argument.

proof.text:
Write $C^W_{L/E}=-\otimes^L_{\widehat R_{E,W}}\widehat R_{L,W}$, and let $\beta_{L/E}:C^X_{L/E}F_E\xrightarrow{\sim}F_LC^Z_{L/E}$ be exactly the ambient comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. The natural maps $\chi^W:C^W\to S^W$ are isomorphisms on complete inputs by [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Define
$$N_{L/E,K}=\chi^X_{L/E,F_EK}\circ\beta_{L/E,K}^{-1}\circ F_L((\chi^Z_{L/E,K})^{-1}),$$
and
$$d_{L/E,K}=S^X_{L/E}(\psi_{E,K})\circ N_{L/E,K}\circ(\psi_{L,S^Z_{L/E}K})^{-1}.$$
These formulas give the asserted direction $I_LS^Z_{L/E}\to S^X_{L/E}I_E$. Every factor is a natural isomorphism; Step 1 supplies all its complete constructible inputs and outputs. Thus they define natural isomorphisms on the full categories in the statement, with the required normalization.

proof.text:
For $E\subset L\subset M$, abbreviate the extensions by $a=L/E$, $b=M/L$, $c=M/E$. Write $A_C^W:C_b^WC_a^W\to C_c^W$ for ordinary tensor associativity and $A_S^W:S_b^WS_a^W\to S_c^W$ for its strict-tower counterpart. By [lem-fix-scalar-completion-associator], with
$$h^W_K=S_b^W(\chi^W_{a,K})\circ\chi^W_{b,C_a^WK},$$
one has $A^W_{S,K}h^W_K=\chi^W_{c,K}A^W_{C,K}$. This is the associator that rationalizes to the prescribed $a^W$: [lem-pur-completed-line-tensor-coherence] identifies its scalar associators with those of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Expand the three $N$'s in Step 3. Naturality of $\chi_b$ moves it past $\beta_a^{-1}$, and the displayed equation replaces $A_Sh$ by $\chi_cA_C$ on each site. Precompose with the isomorphism $F_M(h^Z_K)$ and cancel the common final $\chi^X_{c,F_EK}$. The required equation becomes exactly
$$A^X_CF_E\circ C_b^X(\beta_a^{-1})\circ\beta_{b,C_a^Z}^{-1}=\beta_c^{-1}\circ F_M(A_C^Z),$$
the successive-extension coherence of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], with its comparisons inverted. Cancelling the precomposition back gives
$$A^X_SF_E\circ S_b^X(N_a)\circ N_{b,S_a^Z}=N_c\circ F_M(A_S^Z).$$
For a repeated field the same calculation uses the multiplication/completeness units instead of $h$; the unit normalization of $\chi_{E/E}$ and the ambient unit comparison give $N_{E/E}=\operatorname{id}$ under those units.

proof.text:
Substitute $d_a=S_a^X(\psi_E)N_a\psi_L^{-1}$ and $d_b=S_b^X(\psi_L)N_b\psi_M^{-1}$ into $A_S^X I_E\circ S_b^X(d_a)\circ d_{b,S_a^Z}$. The adjacent factors $S_b^X(\psi_L^{-1})S_b^X(\psi_L)$ cancel. Naturality of $A_S^X$ then gives
$$S_c^X(\psi_E)\circ A_S^XF_E\circ S_b^X(N_a)\circ N_{b,S_a^Z}\circ\psi_{M,S_b^ZS_a^Z}^{-1}.$$
Use Step 4, then naturality of $\psi_M$ for $A_S^Z$, in the form $F_M(A_S^Z)\psi_{M,S_b^ZS_a^Z}^{-1}=\psi_{M,S_c^Z}^{-1}I_M(A_S^Z)$. The result is $d_c\circ I_M(A_S^Z)$, the integral cocycle. For $L=E$, Step 4 makes $N$ the identity under the scalar unit; naturality of $\psi_E$ for that unit cancels the remaining $\psi_E$ and its inverse. Thus $d_{E/E}$ is the identity under the prescribed units.

proof.text: The specified quotient-completion map $\chi$ commutes with ordinary tensor shifts and the native product-cone shifts by [lem-weil-completed-scalar-chain-shift]. The ambient $\beta$ commutes with shifts by [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Hence the formula of Step 3 for $d$ is shift compatible: Step 6 supplies that property for $\psi$, and inverses of shift-compatible isomorphisms satisfy the reversed shift square by cancellation. Composition and whiskering preserve these squares by [lem-weil-pbc-commshift-nattrans-comp-whisker].
